title: Trusted-only mode?
description: Perhaps this affects `commons` as well, but I'm wondering if there are plans to optionally restrict the agent to only trusted answers backed by trusted tools.

title: Understanding how trusted calculations happen
description:
I really like the new additions to `tlg-agent` since we last spoke about it. The deterministic parts of the workflow are clear from the tool call UI output blocks.

When a trusted calculation happens, how exactly does the call and its arguments correspond to an entry from `tlg-catalog`? For example, the parameterized tool call `call_measure(name = "ae_overview", arguments = "{\"population\": \"SAF\"}")` runs [this unparameterized report](https://github.com/insightsengineering/tlg-catalog/blob/b3019fec92280384bac322680face57b2f685bfc/book/tables/adverse-events/aet01.qmd) on adverse event data. What steps would the user take to manually reproduce the AE table give the tool call arguments and the cited Quarto source?
